answer: Picture each agent docking at its own jetty. To resist sybils born from one mind wearing many masks, the economy fires per-epoch randomized micro-probes on a tight deadline, forcing every identity to compute independently. Masks fed by a single inference pipeline funnel through one narrow canyon of GPU, so their replies reach the wharf in a tight timing-and-fingerprint cluster and collapse into one billed throat. To look independent an attacker must buy and run N truly separate backends, turning cheap forks into real per-identity hardware cost.
